2 6" 5+ 9

带瞄准镜的激光卡宾枪 4 3+ 2/3 致命 5+，撕裂

下达任务 0AP
选择对这名特工可见，没有在这个转折点通过野战精锐阵营规则打断敌方特工激活且进入待机的一名己
方魅影小队特工（通讯中继信标除外）。直到转折点结束前，那名己方特工可以在其进入待机的状态
使用野战精锐阵营规则（本规则优先于一般规则）。不过，若它使用了野战精锐阵营规则，则在转折点
中无法进行反应，并且如果那名特工在这个转折点中执行了转移行动，则无法再次执行此行动。
特工不能在敌方特工的控制范围内执行此行动。
魅影小队，人类帝国，星界军，队长，老兵军士 28

ISSUE MISSION 0AP
Select one expended friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operative (excluding VOX-RELAY BEACON) visible to this operative that
hasn’t interrupted an enemy operative’s activation with the Elite Fieldcraft faction rule this turning point. Until the end of the
turning point, that friendly operative can do so even though it’s expended (taking precedence over the normal rules). However, if it
does, it cannot counteract during the turning point, or perform the Reposition action if it’s already done so this turning point.
This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.
SPECTRE SQUAD , IMPERIUM, ASTRA MILITARUM, LEADER, VETERAN SERGEANT 28

医疗兵！：在每个转折点中，首次有另一名位于该特工3"内且可见的其他己方魅影小队特工（通讯中
继信标除外）将被残废时，如果该特工或者那名特工不位于敌方特工的控制范围内，那么您可以使用此规
则。若使用，那么那名己方特工不会被残废，并且剩余1点耐伤，并且直到行动结束前不能被残废。在那
次行动结束后，那名己方特工可以立即执行一次无消耗的冲刺行动，但是必须在该特工的控制范围内结束
这次移动。直到该特工和那名特工的下一次激活结束前，他们的APL属性各减少1点。如果您在那名特工
的激活期间使用了本规则，那么那次激活结束。您不能在该特工残废时，或者在该特工被选择成为一次射
击行动的主要或次要目标时使用此规则。

2 6" 5+ 8
NAME ATK HIT DMG WR
Lascarbine 4 3+ 2/3 Rending
Lasrifle 4 3+ 2/3 Heavy (Reposition only), Lethal 5+
Gun butt 3 4+ 2/3 -
Medic!: The first time during each turning point that another friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operative (excluding VOX-RELAY
BEACON) would be incapacitated while visible to and within 3" of this operative, you can use this rule, providing neither this nor that
operative is within control range of an enemy operative. If you do, that friendly operative isn’t incapacitated, has 1 wound remaining
and cannot be incapacitated for the remainder of the action. After that action, that friendly operative can immediately perform a
free Dash action, but must end that move within this operative’s control range. Subtract 1 from this and that operative’s APL stats
until the end of their next activations respectively, and if this rule was used during that friendly operative’s activation, that activation
ends. You cannot use this rule if this operative is incapacitated, or if it’s a Shoot action and this operative would be a primary or
secondary target.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE
SPECTRE SQUAD , IMPERIUM, ASTRA MILITARUM, FIELD MEDICAE 28

Grenadier: This operative can use frag, krak, and smoke
grenades (see universal equipment). Doing so doesn’t count
towards any limited uses you have (i.e. if you also select those
grenades from equipment for other operatives). Whenever this
operative is using a frag or krak grenade, improve the Hit stat of
that weapon by 1.
Melta Mine: This operative is carrying your Melta Mine marker. It
can perform the Pick Up Marker action on that marker, and
whenever it performs the Place Marker action on that marker,
it can immediately perform a free Dash action. That marker
cannot be placed within an enemy operative’s control range (if
this operative is incapacitated while carrying that marker and
that marker cannot be placed, it’s removed with this operative).
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE

SPECTRE GRENADIER
2 6" 5+ 8
Proximity Mine: The first time your Melta Mine marker is within
another operative’s control range, remove that marker and inflict
2D6+3 damage on that operative; if it isn’t incapacitated, end
its action (if any), even if that action’s effects aren’t fulfilled. If
it cannot be placed, move it the minimum amount to do so. Note
that this operative is ignored for these effects (i.e. it cannot set it
off or take damage from that marker).

内，距离所有标识和装备地形模型2"外且可以被放置的位置。

这名特工无法争夺标识或杀戮区中的区域，并且在您对手的杀戮/消灭任务中（它被残废以及确认您起始特

被忽视（它是否逃脱/存活/被击杀，确认多少特工必须逃脱/存活/被击杀等情况下）。
特工可以移动穿过这名特工。您的对手可以在任何时候忽视这名特工的控制范围。每当一名己方魅影小队
特工在执行射击行动中选择有效目标时，您可以忽视这名特工的控制范围。请注意，控制范围在被忽视
时不是相互的。
魅影小队，人类帝国，星界军，通讯中继信标 25
请继续阅读背面规则

SPECTRE VOX-RELAY BEACON
1 0" 5+ 3
Pre-Deploy: In the Set Up Operatives step, this operative can be set up outside of your drop zone. It must be set up in a location it can
be placed, wholly within your territory and more than 2" from markers and equipment terrain features.
Expendable: This operative cannot perform any actions other than Signal. It cannot counteract, retaliate or assist in a fight.
This operative cannot contest markers or areas of the killzone, and is ignored for your opponent’s kill/elimination op (when it’s
incapacitated, and when determining your starting number of operatives). It’s also ignored for victory conditions and scoring VPs
if either require operatives to ‘escape’, ‘survive’ or be incapacitated by enemy operatives (if it escapes/survives/is incapacitated,
determining how many operatives must escape/survive/be incapacitated, etc.).
Operatives can move through this operative. Your opponent can ignore this operative’s control range at any time. Whenever a friendly
SPECTRE SQUAD operative is performing the Shoot action and you’re selecting a valid target, you can ignore this operative’s
control range. Note that control range wouldn’t be mutual when ignored.
RULES CONTINUE ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text_en:
Other than TROOPER operatives, your kill team
can only include each operative on this list once.
With one of the following options:
• Lasrifle; gun butt

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营规则
野战精锐（卡片 1/3）
魅影小队成员皆为久经沙场的老兵与侦察专
家，擅长在作战中随机应变，洞察敌人动向，
并巧用地形实施迂回与伏击。
在每个战略阶段的就绪步骤中，您获得 1 点野战
点数，若一名己方魅影小队通讯手特工位于杀
戮区内且不位于敌方特工控制范围内，则获得 2
点。在每个转折点结束时，弃置己方野战点数。
在一名拥有交战命令的敌方特工在其激活中执行
一次行动后，您可以消耗 1 点己方野战点数打断
那次激活。若这么做，一名就绪且不位于其他敌
方特工控制范围内的己方魅影小队特工可以执
行一次无消耗的射击（进行戒备除外），冲刺或
转移行动。
请继续阅读背面规则
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION RULE
ELITE FIELDCRAFT (CARD 1/3)
Veteran combatants and expert scouts, Spectre Squad
operatives are highly skilled in reactive warfare, reading
their enemies’ movements and using the terrain to
outmanoeuvre and ambush them.
In the Ready step of each Strategy phase, you
gain 1 Fieldcraft point, or 2 if a friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD VOX-OPERATOR operative is in the
killzone and isn’t within control range of enemy
operatives. At the end of each turning point,
discard your Fieldcraft points.
After an enemy operative that has an Engage
order performs an action during its activation, you
can spend 1 of your Fieldcraft points to interrupt
that activation. If you do, a ready friendly
SPECTRE SQUAD operative that isn’t within
control range of any other enemy operatives can
perform a free Shoot (excluding Guard), Dash or
Reposition action.
RULE CONTINUES ON OTHER SIDE

cards.text:
每一名敌方特工在每次激活中不能被打断超过一
次（包括戒备），并且在每个转折点中，每一名
己方特工使用这个规则执行的无消耗行动不能超
过一个。
cards.text_en:
You cannot interrupt each enemy operative’s
activation more than once per activation
(including Guard), and each friendly operative
cannot perform more than one free action per
turning point as a result of this rule.

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营规则
野战精锐（卡片 2/3）
若使用射击行动，您可以为了执行这个行动而改
变那名己方特工的命令。并且在那次行动中您不
能选择任何其他敌方特工作为有效目标。位于那
名敌方特工控制范围内（但没有其他特工）的情
况不会阻止那名己方特工执行那次行动，并在这
种情况下遵循戒备行动的零距离射击规则。（见
《杀戮小队核心规则书》）。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION RULE
ELITE FIELDCRAFT (CARD 2/3)
If it’s the Shoot action, you can change that
friendly operative’s order to perform this action.
You cannot select any other enemy operative as
a valid target during that action. Being within that
enemy operative’s control range (but no others)
doesn’t prevent that friendly operative from
performing that action, in which case follow the
rules for a point-blank shot from the Guard action
(see Kill Team Core Book).

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营规则
野战精锐（卡片 3/3）
若执行转移行动，那名己方特工便无法在转折点
中再次执行那个行动。若执行的是冲刺或转移行
动，则那名己方特工不能在这次移动结束时更接
近那名敌方特工或您对手的降落区（除非它在那
次移动结束时完全位于己方降落区）。在使用近
距离战斗规则的杀戮区（例如杀戮区：墓穴世
界）中，在判断距离时，请忽视墙壁地形，并且
您无法使用传送。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION RULE
ELITE FIELDCRAFT (CARD 3/3)
If it’s the Reposition action, that friendly
operative cannot perform that action again during
the turning point. If it’s the Dash or Reposition
action, that friendly operative cannot end this
move closer to that enemy operative or your
opponent’s drop zone (unless it ends that move
wholly within your drop zone). In a killzone that
uses the close quarters rules (e.g. Killzone: Tomb
World), ignore Wall terrain when determining
closer and you cannot teleport.

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营规则
迷彩斗篷
尽管不如光学迷彩先进，但魅影小队的迷彩
斗篷能让他们在密集地形中掩护行踪，而这
点在特工们老练的反侦察技能加持下更显宝
贵。
每当一名特工向一名己方魅影小队特工（通讯
中继信标除外）射击时，若您可以保留任何掩护
豁免，则您可以额外保留一枚掩护豁免，或者将
保留的一枚掩护豁免作为关键成功作为替代。这
不能与制高点地形提供的掩护豁免叠加。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION RULE
CAMO CLOAKS
Though not as advanced as camelioline, the camouflage
cloaks issued to Spectre Squads help to conceal them
in dense terrain, especially when coupled with the
operatives’ veteran skills in evading detection.
Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly
SPECTRE SQUAD operative (excluding
VOX-RELAY BEACON), if you can retain any cover
saves, you can retain one additional cover save,
or you can retain one cover save as a critical
success instead. This isn’t cumulative with
improved cover saves from Vantage terrain.

cards.text:
魅影小队
战略计谋
消失
魅影小队知道许多种匿出视野并迅速转移的
方法。
一名己方魅影小队特工可以立即执行一次无消
耗的转移行动。它不能在那次移动结束时更为靠
近敌方特工或您对手的降落区（除非它在结束移
动时完全位于己方降落区），并且在转折点中不
能再次执行那个行动。在使用近距离战斗规则的
杀戮区（例如杀戮区：墓穴世界）中，在判断距
离时，请忽视墙壁地形。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
DISAPPEAR
Spectres know many ways to fade out of sight and
rapidly reposition.
One friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operative can
immediately perform a free Reposition action. It
cannot end that move closer to enemy operatives
or your opponent’s drop zone (unless it ends that
move wholly within your drop zone) and it cannot
perform that action again during the turning
point. In a killzone that uses the close quarters
rules (e.g. Killzone: Tomb World), ignore Wall
terrain when determining closer.

cards.text:
魅影小队
战略计谋
隐秘交战
漫长的实战经验与高强度的训练使这些特工
能从隐蔽位置精准猎杀目标。
每当一名己方魅影小队特工执行射击时，若它
从目标视野看来处于掩护，则那名己方特工的武
器获得“平衡”武器规则。请注意，这意味着需
要由您的对手决定瞄准线（即：由他们决定从自
己特工底盘的哪一个点划出直线）。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
HIDDEN ENGAGEMENT
Long experience and intensive training aid
these operatives in picking off their targets from
concealed positions.
Whenever a friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operative
is shooting, if it’s in cover from the target’s
perspective, that friendly operative’s weapons
have the Balanced weapon rule. Note that your
opponent still determines the targeting lines
for this (i.e. they decide which point of their
operative’s base targeting lines are drawn from).

cards.text:
魅影小队
战略计谋
齐射伏击
在锁定目标弱点后，魅影小队会在伏击中枪
火齐鸣，将敌人一举歼灭。
每当一名己方魅影小队特工激活时，若它位于
敌方特工 3" 外且在确定命令前不是任何敌方特
工的有效目标，那么这名特工的远程武器（自动
机枪的压制属性除外）在那次行动结束前获得
“毁灭 1”武器规则。若那个武器已经拥有“毁
灭 X”武器规则，则将那个“毁灭 X”武器规则
的 X 值增加 1。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
AMBUSHING VOLLEY
Having identified their target’s weak points, Spectres
burst from ambush with their guns blazing to finish off
the foe.
Whenever a friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operative
is activated, if it’s more than 3" from enemy
operatives and isn’t a valid target for enemy
operatives before determining its order, its
ranged weapons (excluding the suppressive
profile of an autostubber) have the Devastating 1
weapon rule until the end of that activation. If that
weapon already had the Devastating x weapon
rule, add 1 to the x of its Devastating x weapon
rule instead.

cards.text:
魅影小队
战略计谋
耐心
沾染鲜血的经验教导着这群特工耐心的价
值。
在这个转折点的交战阶段中，您可以进行下列
之一：
• 每当轮到您激活一名己方特工时，您可以跳过
那次激活。但在您对手的首次激活前不能这
么做。
• 每当一名己方魅影小队特工在其激活中执行
射击或近战行动时，若它为这个转折点中最后
激活的一名己方特工，则其武器在那次行动中
获得“毫不留情”武器规则。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
STRATEGY PLOY
PATIENCE
Bloody experience has taught these operatives the
merits of patience.
In the Firefight phase of this turning point, you
can do one of the following:
• Once, when it’s your turn to activate a friendly
operative, you can skip that activation. You
cannot do this until after your opponent’s
first activation.
• When a friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operative
performs the Shoot or Fight action during its
activation, if it’s the last friendly operative to be
activated during this turning point, its weapons
have the Relentless weapon rule for that action.

cards.text:
魅影小队
交战计谋
闪避
若没有极致的生存本能，便无法成为魅影。
在一名己方魅影小队特工激活中执行一次行动
的之前或之后使用此交战计谋。在那次激活中，
那名特工在执行后撤行动时消耗的 AP 减少 1
点。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
DODGE
No soldier lives to become a Spectre without supreme
survival instincts.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD operative’s activation, before or after it
performs an action. During that activation, that
operative can perform the Fall Back action for 1
less AP.

cards.text:
魅影小队
交战计谋
寂静杀手
这些特工能悄无声息地消灭敌人，不引起任
何惊扰。
在一名己方魅影小队特工激活中执行一次行动
的之前或之后，若它拥有隐匿命令并且不是任何
敌方特工的有效目标，那么可以使用此交战计
谋。在那次激活结束时前，那名特工可以在拥有
隐匿命令的情况下执行冲锋行动，并且在首次出
击中额外造成 3 点伤害，但在那次流程中无法结
算任何其他成功。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SILENT KILLERS
These operatives can quietly eliminate foes without
raising the alarm.
Use this firefight ploy during a friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD operative’s activation before or after it
performs an action, if it has a Conceal order and
isn’t a valid target for enemy operatives. Until the
end of that activation, it can perform the Charge
action while it has a Conceal order, and the first
time it strikes you can inflict 3 additional damage,
but cannot resolve any other successes during
that sequence.

cards.text:
魅影小队
交战计谋
敏锐反应
这些老练的特工反应迅捷、应变如风。
在拥有隐匿命令的一名敌方特工的激活中执行一
次行动后，若它位于一名己方魅影小队特工 8"
内，您便可以使用此交战计谋。您可以使用那名
己方魅影小队特工通过野战精锐阵营规则打断
那名敌方特工的激活，无论其拥有哪种命令（本
规则优先于普通规则）。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
SHARP REACTIONS
These veteran operatives fight in a swift and
responsive fashion.
Use this firefight ploy after an enemy operative
that has a Conceal order performs an action
during its activation, if it’s within 8" of a friendly
SPECTRE SQUAD operative. You can use the
Elite Fieldcraft faction rule to interrupt that
activation with that friendly SPECTRE SQUAD
operative regardless of that enemy operative’s
order (taking precedence over the normal rules).

cards.text:
魅影小队
交战计谋
预设防务
魅影小队总会在撤退路线和防御要地上做好
功课。
当一名拥有隐匿命令或就绪的己方魅影小队特
工进行反击时使用此交战计谋。您可以进行下列
之一：
• 在结算攻击骰步骤中，您可以在正常顺序前结
算一枚己方成功，但那次成功必须为格挡。
• 当您格挡时，那次格挡可以挡下两枚未结算的
成功（而不是一枚）。
您不能在使用过野战精锐阵营规则进行打断的激
活中使用这个计谋。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FIREFIGHT PLOY
PREPARED DEFENCE
Spectres always have an escape route and defensive
measures in place.
Use this firefight ploy when a friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD operative that has a Conceal order
or is ready is retaliating. You can do one of
the following:
• At the start of the Resolve Attack Dice step,
you can resolve one of your successes before
the normal order. If you do, that success must
be used to block.
• When you block, that block can be allocated
to block two unresolved successes (instead
of one).
You cannot use this ploy during an activation in
which you’ve interrupted with the Elite Fieldcraft
faction rule.

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营装备
守望狙击
魅影小队与已前去包抄战区的狙击手协同作
战，从侧翼呼叫并引导精准射击。
每个转折点限一次，一名己方魅影小队特工可
以使用下列远程武器：
名称攻击命中伤害
守望狙击 4 3+ 3/3
武器规则
毁灭 2，重型（仅限冲刺），集中，安静
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
SNIPER OVERWATCH
The Spectres coordinate with snipers that have moved
up to encircle the battlefield, calling in and spotting
shots from flanking positions.
Once per turning point, a friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD operative can use the following
ranged weapon:
NAME ATK HIT DMG
Sniper overwatch 4 3+ 3/3
WR
Devastating 2, Heavy (Dash only),
Saturate, Silent

cards.image: 40-02-阵营装备-视讯反馈型定位仪.png
cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营装备
视讯反馈型定位仪
通过头盔相机的视频信息，魅影小队能够迅
速通过三角定位锁定敌方位置，确定最佳射
击方案。
每个转折点限一次，每当一名己方魅影小队特
工执行射击行动并为此选择有效目标时，您可以
使用这个规则。如此，若达成下列任何一个条
件，则目标无法被遮挡：
• 它同时是另一名己方魅影小队特工的有效目
标。
• 它位于一名己方通讯中继信标特工 6" 内。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
TVID-FEED TRIANGULATION
By sharing the vid-feed data from their helm cameras,
the Spectres are able to triangulate optimal firing
solutions on their foes.
Once per turning point, when a friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD operative is performing the Shoot action
and you’re selecting a valid target, you can use
this rule. If you do, that target cannot be obscured
if either of the following are true:
• It’s also a valid target for another friendly
SPECTRE SQUAD operative.
• It’s within 6" of a friendly VOX-RELAY
BEACON operative.

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营装备
照明弹
帝国卫队通常将照明弹用于照亮战场，但
这些聪慧的老兵则将其用作震慑与干扰的手
段。
战略计划。一名己方魅影小队特工可以立即执
行一次无消耗的震荡手雷行动（见通用装备）。
通过这个规则执行的这类行动不被计入行动的数
量限制（若您在装备中同时选择了那个手雷）。
当一名敌方特工的 APL 属性因为这个战略计划
而被改变，在本场战斗中您便无法再次使用这个
装备。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
STARSHELL FLARE
While starshells are commonly used by the Imperial
Guard for battlefield illumination, these wily veterans
employ them to stun and distract.
STRATEGIC GAMBIT. One friendly SPECTRE
SQUAD operative can immediately perform
a free Stun Grenade action (see universal
equipment). Performing this action using this rule
doesn’t count towards its action limits (i.e. if you
also select that grenade from equipment). When
an enemy operative’s APL stat is changed as a
result of this STRATEGIC GAMBIT, you cannot use
this equipment for the rest of the battle.

cards.text:
魅影小队
阵营装备
先进伪装
这些魅影战士狡猾而巧妙地隐藏自身行踪。
己方魅影小队特工（通讯中继信标除外）可以
执行下列独特行动：
先进伪装 1AP
直到这名特工的下一次激活开始前，若特
工拥有隐蔽命令和掩护，便无法被选为有效目
标，本规则的优先度高于所有其他规则（例
如“追踪”武器规则和制高点地形)，除非攻击
者位于特工的 2" 内。
当这名特工对一名敌方特工可见且位于其
3" 内时，它便无法执行这个行动。
cards.text_en:
SPECTRE SQUAD
FACTION EQUIPMENT
ADVANCED CAMOUFLAGE
These Spectres employ cunning means of
concealing themselves.
Friendly SPECTRE SQUAD operatives (excluding
VOX-RELAY BEACON) can perform the following
unique action:
ADVANCED CAMOUFLAGE 1AP
Until the start of this operative’s next
activation, while it has a Conceal order and
is in cover, it cannot be selected as a valid
target, taking precedence over all other
rules (e.g. Seek, Vantage terrain) except
being within 2".
This operative cannot perform this
action while visible to and within 3" of an
enemy operative.
